title: Genesis acceptance-criteria ownership and evidence map
status_rule: Acceptance criteria remain unverified until every required evidence item has been produced against the exact release candidate and all Genesis-blocking findings mapped to that criterion are resolved. EXP-0.2.6 does not mark any criterion satisfied.

criteria.question: Can a user independently inspect and verify the supported blockchain transactions, blocks, and addresses?
verification_method: Execute block, transaction, receipt/log and address API correctness tests against representative canonical fixtures.
Exercise the corresponding user workflows through the production-equivalent Explorer frontend.
Compare displayed chain ID, block hash, transaction/receipt provenance, values and finality with authoritative target-network data.
required_evidence: passing core Explorer API/service tests on the exact release candidate
authoritative-chain comparison witnesses for representative successful and failed transactions
evidence that transaction fees and historical block-producer attribution required by the agreed workflows are implemented and rendered
raw event/log inspectability evidence for the mandatory receipt/logs view

criteria.question: Does the Explorer retrieve and display accurate information from the authoritative 420 Integrated network?
verification_method: Bind 420Indexer to the approved chain-420 RPC/node source and reject wrong-chain sources.
Compare indexed blocks, transactions, receipts/logs, finality and Registry-derived records with canonical upstream data.
Verify Explorer fails closed or clearly reports stale, degraded, wrong-chain or inconsistent data.
required_evidence: authoritative target-network RPC/node identity and chain ID 420 evidence
Explorer presentation evidence preserving canonical provenance

criteria.question: Are all required data-ingestion and indexing processes operational, consistent, and recoverable?
verification_method: Run 420Indexer against the target network through startup synchronization, catch-up and steady-state ingestion.
Exercise restart/resume, RPC outage, lag, provider failure, non-finalized reorg repair, finalized-conflict fail-closed and full-rebuild scenarios.
Verify consensus/validator projections are populated and consistent with the canonical consensus source.
required_evidence: deployed Indexer endpoint and runtime composition evidence
consensus/validator provider wiring and representative data evidence

criteria.question: Are the required smart contract addresses, ABIs, registry references, and protocol integrations correct?
verification_method: Verify frozen system-address assignments against target-network runtime code without changing the frozen map.
Verify ProtocolRegistry code at 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000434 and authorized service/version publications.
Bind ABI/decoder descriptors to compiled release artifacts and deployed Registry/runtime provenance.
Compare Indexer Registry projections with direct canonical Registry reads.
required_evidence: direct Registry vs Indexer projection comparison

criteria.question: Are all Genesis-required user-facing workflows functional?
verification_method: Execute every workflow classified as required by the frozen Explorer Genesis scope through the actual frontend and API.
Verify navigation, search, status/error handling and cross-resource links with representative target-network data.
required_evidence: workflow-by-workflow pass evidence for the final required set

criteria.question: Are the backend APIs, frontend, indexing services, and supporting infrastructure integrated and tested?
verification_method: Deploy the qualified Indexer, Explorer backend and Explorer frontend as one production-equivalent stack.
Exercise all mandatory Explorer-to-Indexer routes and required Registry/consensus provider paths end-to-end.
Run browser/API integration suites and failure-mode tests against the deployed stack.

criteria.question: Are relevant security, data integrity, and operational risks addressed?
verification_method: Run security review/tests over public API input validation, metadata rendering, secrets/configuration, browser handling and infrastructure exposure.
Verify canonical-authority, finality and fail-closed invariants under malformed, stale, wrong-chain and inconsistent inputs.
Exercise production-equivalent recovery and degraded-state scenarios.
required_evidence: security test/review record for the exact release candidate
unsafe/untrusted metadata and log rendering tests
resolved high/critical security findings or documented non-blocking disposition

criteria.question: Are the deployment procedures complete and reproducible?
verification_method: Build and deploy the production-equivalent Explorer/Indexer stack from documented, version-pinned procedures.
Verify environment variables, network configuration, service URLs, startup order, persistence and rollback/recovery instructions.
Repeat deployment from a clean environment and compare resulting service identity/configuration.
required_evidence: complete environment/configuration inventory without unresolved placeholders

criteria.question: Are all required test suites passing against the exact release candidate?
verification_method: Freeze the release-candidate commit and enumerate every required unit, integration, security, deployment and end-to-end suite.
Execute every required suite against that exact commit and required external/runtime environment.
Record pass, fail, skipped and environment-blocked results without substituting earlier-head evidence.
required_evidence: successful results for every mandatory suite
explicit record for any skipped/non-applicable test with accepted rationale
no unresolved regression against the release candidate

criteria.question: Is there sufficient recorded evidence to support the final Genesis qualification decision?
verification_method: Consolidate the immutable evidence for AC-1 through AC-9 against the exact release candidate.
Confirm every Genesis-blocking finding is resolved and every mandatory acceptance criterion is satisfied.
Reconcile final implementation, scope, dependency state, tests and deployment evidence with the authoritative Genesis profile.
required_evidence: complete AC-1 through AC-9 evidence index
exact release-candidate qualification runs and artifact digests
final acceptance checklist with no mandatory criterion left unverified

invariants: Every acceptance criterion must remain unverified until its complete required evidence exists against the applicable exact release candidate.
A passing source-level CI suite does not by itself satisfy a runtime, deployment, integration, security or end-to-end acceptance criterion.
Post-Genesis enhancement findings do not block satisfaction of core Genesis acceptance criteria unless the authoritative Genesis scope is explicitly changed.
EXP-8 is the only milestone authorized by this map to mark the final Genesis acceptance checklist satisfied.
